name: Deployment Cases Closed This FY
query:
SELECT
    u.full_name AS "Owner Name",
    i.case_origin,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cases_closed
FROM
    tabIssue i
JOIN
    tabUser u ON i.case_owner = u.email
WHERE
    YEAR(i.date_and_time_closed) = YEAR(CURDATE()) 
    AND i.status = 'Closed'
    AND u.enabled = 1
GROUP BY
    u.full_name,
    i.case_origin;
